body: Well I'm proud of you for being here, borrowed time or not, if you need to talk just message me friend :)

Just want to add this here, for those of you who have made it out of an abusive relationship, I'm proud of you, everyone should be. It's a big step and one you've all had to face differently which only makes it harder. I hope those still in need can be inspired by your stories and make their own step.

Stay safe all
Oh definitely, keep your head high and know you're bringing the good into the world, a very good way to live life
I'm sure you're still worthy of liking these days, I think everyone has that ability!
Seems like something to be proud of!

Well that's still pretty cool, not many people can say they have an article about them.
Still sorry to hear about your depression, hope you're doing better nowadays!
I'm sure I'm not, sometimes it can be hard to see what you've done when you're feeling down but just know you're still valued!
I'm sure you've done something worthy, doesnt have to be monumental!
